miso.definition: n. a thick paste made from fermented soybeans and barley or rice malt; used in Japanese cooking to make soups or sauces

misogamist.definition: n. a person who hates marriage

misogamy.translation:
n. 厌恶结婚
[医] 厌婚症

misogynic.definition: s. (used of men) having deep-seated distrust of women

misogynism.translation: [网络] 厌恶女性主义；厌恶女人；厌恶女入

misogynist.definition: n. a misanthrope who dislikes women in particular

misogynistic.translation:
歧视女性的
厌恶女人的

misogynists.definition: n. a misanthrope who dislikes women in particular
misogynists.translation: n. 厌恶女人的人( misogynist的复数形式 )

misogyny.translation:
n. 厌恶女人
[医] 厌女症, 厌恶女人

misoneism.definition: n. hatred of change or innovation
misoneism.translation:
n. 厌新
[医] 厌新症, 守旧主义

misonidazole.translation: 甲氧甲基硝基咪唑乙醇

misoperation.translation:

misophobia.translation:
n. 不洁恐怖

misorder.definition:
v. t. To order ill; to manage erroneously; to conduct badly.
n. Irregularity; disorder.

misorient.translation: vt.使定向错误, 使定位不当, 使定向(或定位)变异, 对…指导不当(亦作misorientate)

misorientation.translation: 定向误差, 取向误差

misoriented.translation: vt. 使定向错误，使定位不当；使定向（定位）变异；对…指导不当（亦作misorientate）

misoshiru.translation: [网络] 味噌汤；酱汤；日本酱汤
